slices.focus: A hot-week produce run goes sideways with dumped milk and spoiled produce, validating Eric's earlier readiness analysis and earning a formal 90-day cold-chain pilot from leadership, which transforms his role from informal patcher to sanctioned pilot leader.
slices.summary: A visible spoilage failure during a heat week, documented with photos and spoilage sheets, convinces leadership to approve a 90-day cold-chain pilot with tighter handoff windows, pre-call confirmation, and route-compliance tracking.
